subject: HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 mounting style
side_a: keeb.io-era research claim: mid-mount, sits in a pcb cutout to reduce board-to-connector thickness (evid-typ-011, original listing unreachable)
side_b: LCSC component page C165948 for the same part: mounting type surface mount, right angle (live sept 27 2026)
resolution_path: pull the official HRO datasheet for TYPE-C-31-M-12 and check the mechanical drawing before circuitron treats it as a mid-mount footprint
resolution: resolved by the official HRO datasheet drawing: edge-mount over the pcb edge with smt contacts plus 4 through-board shield tabs, not mid-mount. the lcsc surface-mount attribution was closer to truth; the mid-mount cutout claim is retired. circuitron may use the part as an edge-mount usb-c with board-edge slots. evidence line evid-typ-012.
